page.layout: One scan showing a book's fore-edge and spine from the side: no printed page is visible, only the edge of a closed text block between two pale vellum or parchment boards on a dark background.
page.notes: The scan shows the edge of a closed book (the text block with its page edges, flanked by pale cover boards). No printed text, running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible, so there is nothing to transcribe. The dark background and the digitiser's white margin are not part of the page.
